messages:
Priya (PM): quick proposal for rollout pattern for the new rollout (feature flags + canaries + staged regions). TL;DR: three-phase lattice with fast fallback hooks, guarded A/B sample for quality checks, and token-cost-aware routing. want alignment before i write the spec.
Dan (Eng): sounds good. can you sketch the phases? wanting to confirm we don't do a single all-or-nothing cutover.
Priya (PM): phase 0 = internal + dev orgs (5% traffic from internal test accounts), phase 1 = beta customers (10% of eligible tenants across 2 regions), phase 2 = regional ramp to 100% with staggered RPS windows. each phase has a canary window and a decision gate.
Eleni (Infra): for phase 1 canary we should pin to specific edge pools to avoid cross-region noise. propose pool tags: edge:canary-1, canary-2. also we need an autoscale cap so burst doesn't blow budget.
Zach (SRE): guardrails idea: abort conditions are p95 latency > 1.5x baseline or error-rate > 1% sustained for 5m, quality-regression alert (see eval set) or token-cost delta > 20%. If any trigger flips, immediate circuit to fallback model + flag rollback.
Maya (ProductOps): how do we validate subjective quality in the canary? we need both automated evals and 2 product reviewers on rotation. propose: automated eval every 10k calls vs golden prompts, and a small manual review cohort for edge cases.
Dan (Eng): for fallback policy, recommend we default to smaller quantized model variant (compact-quant) before cutting traffic. that keeps latency and reduces cost; if that fails, route to hosted-safe endpoint (regional fallback).
Priya (PM): exact rollout increments: phase1 table -> 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 10% over 24 hours if all gates pass. each step has a 30m hold with metric checks. Phase2 per-region ramp: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 1h holds.
Dan (Eng): flag layout suggestion: single feature flag tree + rollout factor and cohort tags. example config snippet: 
```
feature_flags:
  response_streaming_v2.enabled: false
  response_streaming_v2.rollout.percent: 0
  response_streaming_v2.rollout.cohorts: ["internal","beta-1","eu-canary"]
```
we'll use server-side evaluation to set bucket membership.
Zach (SRE): add a global kill-switch flag and an emergency fallback route named fallback:compact-quant. also ops runbook must include manual-override commands.
OpsBot: deploy-bot: will emit canary events and create ephemeral alerts during the rollout window. add `--canary` to deploy command to get automatic annotations.
Maya (ProductOps): customer communications - need a short email + status page template for beta customers. also charting: p95, p99, 99.9, avg tokens per call, cost-per-1000, and error ratio.
Priya (PM): launch criteria checklist draft:
- infra: autoscale limits + pool pinning configured
- flags: rollout config validated in staging
- metrics: baseline collected and test alerts wired
- quality: automated eval pass (no regression > 2% on golden set) + 2 manual samples OK
- docs: quickstart, fallback behaviour, runbook linked
- comms: customer email + status page template ready
if any fail, we do a rollback and postmortem.
Dan (Eng): scope negotiation: i can deliver the flagging and fallback logic in 2 sprints if we keep manual review to one rotation. if we add live human-in-loop gating we need +1 sprint.
Eleni (Infra): i'll own pool tagging + autoscale caps. need list of tenant IDs for phase1 to pre-warm caches.
Zach (SRE): i'll draft runbook snippets and the alert thresholds. ops on-call should confirm they can escalate within 10m.
Priya (PM): action items: @Dan implement flag gating + fallback (owner Dan), @Eleni configure canary pools and pre-warm (owner Eleni), @Zach write runbook + alerts (owner Zach), @Maya prepare beta comms + manual review schedule (owner Maya). i'll draft the spec doc with timeline and attach tomorrow.
Maya (ProductOps): +1, also put a note to EU legal for data residency check for eu-canary.
Dan (Eng): one more technical note — we should expose a per-request header to opt-out from canary for customer debugging: `X-Redwood-Bypass-Canary: true`. ops should have whitelist.
Zach (SRE): ack, whitelist + audit log for bypass usage required.
Priya (PM): ok next step: i'll post full spec in docs repo and request a sync if anyone wants to push back. aim to start phase0 next Tuesday. thanks all :tada:
Maya (ProductOps): noted. adding calendar invite for rollout sync.
OpsBot: incident-bot: reminder set for canary-monitoring channel 24h before phase1 start.
Priya (PM): thanks — closing thread for now, will link the spec when published.
